# Phase Two — Gevurah Critique and Risk Boundaries

The Awtsmoos gives expansion through Chesed and boundary through Gevurah; Awtsmoos.com should improve the Social Hub without converting a focused UI mission into unrelated infrastructure churn.

## Risks to constrain
1. Do not duplicate the same 12-route traversal inside two giant browser files.
2. Do not weaken route-quality assertions just to get green output.
3. Do not create a route-local override for shared Universal Chat behavior.
4. Do not edit generated assets.
5. Do not exceed 120 lines in touched human-authored source/test files.
6. Do not partially patch existing files; rewrite complete touched files.
7. Do not introduce external social-provider integration.
8. Do not publish real posts or mutate real user data.
9. Do not change source-control staging/commit state.
10. Do not rely on a green heartbeat as proof that a command ran.
11. Do not claim a combined suite passed unless the exact final-tree command completes.
12. Do not let stale REMAINING_WORK contradict disk reality.
13. Do not force every inline text link to 44px when its semantic context is intentionally prose.
14. Do require primary/standalone controls to maintain practical touch geometry.
15. Do not treat browser infrastructure failure as an application failure.
16. Do not hide a browser infrastructure failure as an application success either.
17. Do not overbuild future provider-linking abstractions while they are excluded.
18. Do not add meaningless mystical wrappers; Kabbalistic naming must describe real responsibility.
19. Do not create a monolithic mega-test; keep inspector, journey, runner, and smoke roles distinct.
20. Do not silently leave the standalone audit outside CI/default developer commands.
21. Do not change shared Chat styling without checking its public app consumer.
22. Do not shorten comments to make line budgets fit; split responsibilities instead.
23. Do not use space indentation in touched JS/CSS where tabs are valid.
24. Do not stop after package wiring; rerun both focused and full verification.
25. Do not close until the final ledger matches actual completed/pending work.

## Stronger design choice
Keep `browserSmoke.test.mjs` focused on one integrated user journey. Keep `browserSurfaceQuality.test.mjs` focused on exhaustive 12-route rendered-surface invariants. Wire both under `test:browser` so default browser verification runs the complementary witnesses without duplicating their internals.

The boundary is mercy: the Awtsmoos reveals more by refusing false excess, and Awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when each test keeps one covenant and every covenant joins the whole.
